functions.name: WithBuildEnvironment
functions.description: Adds an environment variable to the build process for a .NET project.
functions.remarks:
This method supports project files (`.csproj`) only. File-based C# apps (`.cs`) do not support
build-only environment variables.
The variable is available while Aspire builds the project but is not added to the environment of the
launched project. Use `WithEnvironment` separately when the same variable is also needed at runtime.
Configuring a build environment causes Aspire to build this project separately from traversal groups.
When publishing a container, do not use this API to set MSBuild properties that control the output artifact's
identity, destination, format, or target platform. Aspire rejects those properties because downstream
publishing steps use the values configured with `WithContainerBuildOptions`.
Do not use this API for secrets. Aspire must carry the value in IDE launch metadata and process environments,
and the value can appear in build diagnostics. Protected temporary MSBuild response files preserve
global-property semantics without exposing values in process command lines, but they are not a general-purpose
secret transport.
functions.returns: A reference to the `IResourceBuilder`1` for chaining additional configuration.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the environment variable.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value of the environment variable.

handleTypes.name: DotnetProjectResource
handleTypes.description: A resource that represents a specified C# project or file-based app added by path.
handleTypes.remarks:
A `DotnetProjectResource` is added by path and is
launched as an executable: `dotnet run --project <path>` for a project file, or
`dotnet run --file <path>` for a file-based app (a `.cs` file).
Resources created by `AddDotnetProject` support the same .NET SDK container-publishing pipeline as
resources created by `AddProject`. A directly constructed resource must be given project metadata and
explicitly configured for publishing by its builder.
